EC1: History or known presence of central nervous system metastases.
EC2: History of another malignancy [NOT] except: Malignancy [OR] treated with curative intent and with [NOT] no known active disease present for >=5 years prior to enrolment and felt to be at low risk for recurrence by the treating physician; Adequately treated [AND] non-melanomatous skin cancer [OR] or lentigo maligna [OR] [NOT] without evidence of disease; Adequately treated [AND] cervical carcinoma in situ  [NOT] without evidence of disease; Prostatic intraepithelial neoplasia [AND] [NOT] without evidence of prostate cancer.
EC3: Known immediate [OR] or delayed hypersensitivity reaction [OR] or idiosyncrasy [AND] to drugs chemically related to panitumumab [OR] or excipients that contraindicates their participation.
EC4: Prior anti-epidermal growth factor receptor [OR] (EGFr) antibody therapy (e.g., panitumumab [OR] or cetuximab) or treatment with small molecule EGFr inhibitors (e.g., gefitinib [OR], erlotinib [OR], lapatinib).
EC5: Antitumor therapy [OR] (e.g., chemotherapy [OR], hormonal therapy [OR], immunotherapy [OR], antibody therapy [OR], radiotherapy), or investigational agent [OR] or therapy  <=30 days before first dose of study treatment [OR] or not recovered from any acute toxicity.
EC6: Other investigational procedure <=30 days before study entry.
EC7: History of interstitial lung disease (ILD) e.g., interstitial pneumonitis [OR], pulmonary fibrosis [OR] or evidence of ILD [AND] on baseline chest computer tomography.
EC8: Subject previously enrolled to this study.
EC9: History of keratitis [OR], ulcerative keratitis [OR] or severe dry eye.
EC10: Major surgery [AND] (e.g., requiring general anesthesia) <=30 days before first dose of study treatment. Subjects must have recovered from any surgery related toxicities.
EC11: Minor surgical procedure  (e.g., open biopsy) <=7 days before first dose of study treatment [OR], or [NOT] not yet recovered [AND] from prior minor surgery Note: uncomplicated placement of vascular access device, fine needle aspiration, thoracocentesis or paracentesis >=3 days prior to first dose of study treatment is acceptable.
EC12: Clinically significant cardiovascular disease (including myocardial infarction [OR], unstable angina [OR], symptomatic congestive heart failure [OR], serious uncontrolled cardiac arrhythmia) <=6 months prior to enrolment.
EC13: History of any medical [OR] or psychiatric condition or laboratory abnormality that in the opinion of the investigator may increase the risk associated with the study participation or investigational product administration, compliance with the study procedures [OR] or may interfere with the interpretation of the results.
EC14: Unstable pulmonary embolism [OR], deep vein thrombosis [OR], or other significant arterial [OR]/venous thromboembolic event <=30 days before first dose of study treatment. If on anticoagulation [OR], subject must be on stable therapeutic dose prior to first dose of study treatment.
EC15: Subject who is pregnant [OR] or breast feeding [OR], or planning to become pregnant during treatment and within 2 months after the discontinuation of study treatment.
EC16: Known positive test(s) for human immunodeficiency virus infection (testing is not required in the absence of clinical suspicion).
EC17: Active infection  requiring systemic treatment [OR] or any uncontrolled infection <=14 days prior to first dose of study treatment ([NOT] with the exception of uncomplicated urinary tract infection [OR] or upper respiratory tract infection).
EC18: Subject has any kind of disorder that compromises the ability of the subject to give written informed consent and/or to comply with study procedures or is unwilling or unable to comply with study requirements.
